等待本机CS2窗口处于前台: Waiting for the local CS2 window to be foreground
自动扳机正在等待当前条件: Triggerbot is waiting for valid conditions
当前游戏尚未提供自动扳机: Triggerbot is unavailable for this game
当前游戏尚无经过核验的 Hitbox 检测与自动点击支持。: Verified hitbox detection and automatic clicks are not yet available for this game.
自行瞄准，射击方向进入敌人 Hitbox 时自动单击左键。: Aim manually; click automatically when the shot ray intersects an enemy hitbox.
启用后在本机CS2处于前台时持续检测，不需要按住侧键。不会移动准星；可与现有Ai: Checks continuously while the local CS2 window is foreground, without holding a side button. Does not move your aim; works alongside Aimbot or RCS.
请输入有效区间，上限须大于或等于下限: Enter a valid range with the maximum at or above the minimum.
填写 50–1000 ms 的整数区间。每次提交点击后按截断正态分布抽取下一次的: Enter an integer range within 50–1000 ms. After each click request, the next minimum interval is sampled from a truncated normal distribution centered on the range midpoint.
填写 5–40 ms 的整数区间。每次点击按截断正态分布抽取一个时长，到时由固件: Enter an integer range within 5–40 ms. A truncated normal distribution selects the hold time for each click. The firmware then releases the button.
开启后检查射击视点到 Hitbox 首个交点的静态掩体。路径遮挡或无法核验时暂停: Checks static cover between the shot origin and the first hitbox intersection. A blocked or unknown path pauses clicks. Turning off cover also pauses its reaction-time check.
仅狙击枪使用此判定。当前武器的完整 Inaccuracy 必须有效且严格小于设定: Applies to sniper rifles only. The current weapon's full Inaccuracy must be valid and strictly below the limit. Enter a value from 0 to 1. The default is 0.004.
等待当前狙击枪的有效 Inaccuracy: Waiting for valid Inaccuracy from the current sniper rifle
狙击枪 Inaccuracy 未低于设定上限: Sniper Inaccuracy is at or above the limit
仅用于扳机的命中预测。预测时长为采样年龄加预计执行延迟，再加自修正时间差，最低: Applies to Triggerbot hit prediction. The prediction horizon is sample age plus expected execution delay plus this offset, with a minimum of 0 ms. Negative values shorten the horizon and positive values extend it. Enter an integer from -100 to 100 ms. The default is 0 ms.
当前盒子固件不支持点击，请升级到 v7.1 或兼容版本: This firmware cannot click. Upgrade to v7.1 or a compatible version.
你正在按住左键，暂停自动点击: Physical left button is held; automatic clicks paused
当前数据已过期或时钟尚未就绪: Sample is stale or clock is not ready
等待有弹药且未换弹的枪械: Waiting for a loaded firearm that is not reloading
等待完整的原生射击方向与后坐数据: Waiting for complete native shot direction and recoil data
射线未命中目标: The shot ray did not intersect a target
等待完整且匹配的原生命中体姿态: Waiting for complete matching hitbox poses
射线已命中符合条件的目标，准备点击: The shot ray intersects an included target. Preparing to click.
已提交一次左键点击请求: A finite left-button click was requested
设备通道忙，等待重新核验: Output channel is busy; checking again
起点使用已核验的射击视点，方向包含原生眼角基准与当前P/U后坐。使用资源Hitb: Uses the verified shooting eye position, native angle basis and current P/U recoil. Intersects resource hitboxes transformed by the current complete bone poses.
每次左键按下20ms后由固件自行抬起；同一数据帧最多触发一次。物理左键优先，断流: Firmware releases each click after 20 ms. At most one click per source capture. Physical buttons take priority; automatic presses are finite even if data or the session stops.
本版仅做命中体几何检测，不判断掩体、穿透和随机散布；几何相交不保证服务器最终命中: This version checks hitbox geometry only, without cover, penetration or random spread. An intersection does not guarantee a server hit.
当前固件支持5–40ms，按下后自动抬起。: Current firmware supports 5–40 ms, followed by automatic release.
仅判断静态掩体；开启后，遮挡或无法判断时不触发。: Checks static cover only. When enabled, blocked or unknown paths do not trigger.
反应时间仅保存设置，暂未生效。: Saved for later; reaction time is not applied yet.
掩体遮挡，暂停点击: Cover blocks the shot; clicking paused
无法确定掩体状态，暂停点击: Cover state is unknown; clicking paused
每次左键按下所设时长后由固件自行抬起；同一数据帧最多触发一次。物理左键优先，断流: Firmware releases the left button after the configured duration. Each capture can trigger at most once. Physical input takes priority; automatic presses remain finite even if data or the session stops.
可选择静态掩体判断；不模拟穿透和随机散布，几何相交不保证服务器最终命中。反应时间: Optional static-cover checks. Penetration and random spread are not simulated; geometry does not guarantee a server hit. Reaction time settings are not active yet.
每个符合常规包含对象设置的目标至少有一个骨点可见时独立计时，全部被遮挡后重新计时: Each included target has its own timer, starting when any bone is visible. Full cover resets that timer. Reading, transmission and processing count toward the configured delay. Remaining wait can reach zero.
可选择静态掩体判断。开启后可同时启用反应时间判定，按各目标首次露出骨点分别计时，: Static cover checks are optional. When enabled, a reaction timer can start for each target on the first visible bone and reset under full cover.
等待当前目标的反应时间: Waiting for the current target’s reaction timer
当前目标没有可见骨点，反应计时已清零: The current target has no visible bones. Its reaction timer has reset.
使用已核验的 Reader 数据；未知模型、缺失数据或不匹配的姿态不补默认值。: Uses verified Reader data. Unknown models, missing data and mismatched poses are not replaced with default values.
当前枪械类型未启用自动扳机: Triggerbot is disabled for this weapon type
狙包括 AWP、SSG 08、G3SG1、SCAR-20；其他枪为其余已识别枪械: Sniper rifles include AWP, SSG 08, G3SG1 and SCAR-20. Other firearms cover the remaining reviewed guns. The current weapon is matched automatically; each switch is saved independently. Knives, grenades and unknown items do not trigger.
填写 50–1000 ms 的整数。两次点击之间至少间隔所设时长。: Enter a whole number from 50 to 1000 ms. This is the minimum time between clicks.
拖动两端或输入 5–40 ms 的整数。每次点击按所选分布抽取时长。: Drag either handle or enter a whole number from 5 to 40 ms. Each hold duration is sampled from the selected distribution.
